name: cartopy-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Cartopy, a Python library for cartographic projections, geospatial
data handling and map drawing with Matplotlib.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the cartopy package under lib/cartopy together with the documentation that describes it: the docs/source guides and reference pages, the README and the example gallery.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
